sentences.text:
Sarafat Hossain vs Unknown on 30 August, 2018
 43 30.08.2018
Aloke Court 28 C.R.M. 6827 of 2018
In Re : An application for bail under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure filed on
29.08.2018 in connection with Bongaon P.S. Case No. 313 of 2018 dated 05.05.2018 under Sections
272/273 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954
and Section 284 of the West Bengal Municipal Act.

And In the matter of : Sarafat Hossain ...Petitioner Mr. Sourav Chatterjee Ms. Sofia Neser ... for the Petitioner Mr. Arun Kr. Maity, ld. A.P.P. Mr. Sanjay Bardhan Mr. Saryati Dutta Rejected ... for the State

Having considered the materials on record prima facie disclosing involvement of the petitioner in the alleged conspiracy of dealing in rotten meat and other food products which are harmful for human consumption, we are of the opinion that this is not a fit case to grant bail to the petitioner.
The application for bail is, accordingly, rejected.

(Ravi Krishan Kapur,J.) (Joymalya Bagchi, J.)
